In addition to Sections 2303.4.1 through 2303.4.5, the design, manufacture and quality assurance of glued prefabricated parallel chord wood trussesmust be acceptable to the commissioner. Job-site inspections shall be in compliance with Sections 1705.5.2 and 1705.5.3, as applicable.
(Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2023/077.
